name: ocl-cache
description: Cache molecule directed information in sqlite3
author: Luc Patiny

scripts.check-types: npm run check-types -w backend && npm run check-types -w frontend
scripts.dev: lsof -ti:20822,20823 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test-only && npm run check-types && npm run check-tokens && npm run check-deploy && npm run eslint && npm run prettier && npm run test-e2e
scripts.test-only: npm run test-only -w backend && npm run test-only -w frontend
